entity.description:
Ahura-Mazda rescued Nu'bia from death during her time as the guardian of the internal exit of the Underworld. Eventually Nu'bia and Ahura-Mazda would become lovers.

His twin brother Ahriman, god of evil and darkness, ripped out Ahura-Mazda's golden heart, but he did not expect that Nu'bia would come after him to retrieve the heart with the help of Wonder Woman, so he used shards of the heart to corrupt some super-powered humans to fight them. Ultimately, Ahriman was subdued and taken by Nu'bia to restore Ahura-Mazda to health.
